seed: The pane of lists at the foot of the panel used to shrink to what it held, pinned to the bottom, so the control a person had just clicked moved out from under the pointer: Media to Comps lifted the Library's scope control 65pt, folding Layers dropped its header about 93pt, and a second click on the same spot missed (2026-10-14). At Next defaults with no flag set, every click here is a POINTER click at a fixed window point, taken before anything was clicked, so each one landing is the measurement that nothing moved: Comps then Media at the same two points, the Layers header twice at one point, the Library header twice at one point.

steps.note: Nothing picked: Layers and the Library on Media in the pane at the foot of the panel. The points every click below lands on are read off this layout
Comps clicked by the pointer: the shelf holds less, and the scope control has not moved, so Media is still where it was
The Layers header clicked by the pointer: Layers folds, the pane keeps its height and the header stays where it was clicked, with the Library rising under it
The Library header clicked twice at one point: it folds and opens again, the shelf's control back where it was
